outcome: Fetal MCA doppler indices (PI, RI, S/D, Vm)
Fetal UA doppler indices (PI, RI, S/D, Vm)
cohort: The study included 177 normotensive and 189 hypertensive dichorionic diamniotic (DCDA) twin pregnancies.
finding: In DCDA pregnancies complicated by hypertensive disorders, SGA twins exhibit distinct Doppler deterioration patterns, and customized monitoring strategies based on fetal MCA and UA indices can predict adverse conditions.
cross-section timing: Late DCDA twin pregnancies and post 20-week for urinary protein measurements.
